column2: Start Here opens a local readable guide without a browser or network dependency; Close returns to the hub.
Appearance has a frosted navigation rail, readable compact style previews and visible Apply action.
Wallpapers has a scrollable gallery and always-visible apply controls; selecting a preview does not change the desktop.
Text size has three reachable presets and its own Apply action.
Quick Settings cards have compact balanced spacing, readable descriptions and working pointer navigation.
